remarks: If you love HISTORIC older homes, with charm and character, this is the home for you! Pay a little attention to the details and this 3 bedroom, 2 bath home will be lovely. The dining room is large enough for the whole crew, with a wood burning insert (NRTC), the large living room has a wood burning fireplace (NRTC). The laundry is conveniently located on the second floor, the kitchen is huge (29 X 15), has a center island, pantry, it's own seating area and several work areas, just in case someone wants to help the cook, they won't be underfoot. The 1st floor full bath has a walk-in shower and is located just inside the back hall, (no tracking through the house when you've been playing outside), the 2nd floor full bath has a soaking tub. NOW, take a walk out to the 2 story garage (40 X24)...it has electric, heat and plumbing! There's a parking area, huge workshop, 2nd floor office w/half bath. This garage would be a great place to escape for a few minutes of quiet time and it's large enough for the cars and all of the (large and small people's) toys!
